d: We are seeking a results-driven and analytical Commercial Performance Manager to drive business performance through effective commercial analysis, KPI monitoring, profitability management, and performance optimization.

The role will be responsible for evaluating commercial results, identifying business growth opportunities, monitoring sales and profitability trends, and providing actionable insights to senior management. The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams to ensure commercial objectives are achieved and business performance is continuously improved.
Monitor and evaluate overall commercial performance against business plans, budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.
Develop and maintain commercial performance dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting frameworks.
Analyze sales revenue, volume growth, product mix, customer performance, and channel profitability.
Conduct detailed variance analysis to identify performance gaps, business risks, and improvement opportunities.
Monitor gross margins, contribution margins, pricing effectiveness, and overall commercial profitability.
Evaluate trade promotions, discounts, trade investments, and their impact on sales growth and profitability.
Track sales team and distribution channel performance against targets and identify areas requiring corrective actions.
Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to drive commercial efficiency and business results.
Provide actionable business insights and recommendations to senior management through periodic performance reviews.
Conduct market, competitor, and product performance analysis to support strategic commercial decisions.
Identify opportunities to optimize commercial spending, improve margins, and enhance revenue generation.
Support the development and implementation of performance improvement initiatives across business functions.
Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting of commercial performance information.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.
Professional qualification such as ACCA, CA, CMA, or MBA will be an advantage.
5–8 years of relevant experience in commercial performance management, business analysis, commercial finance, or sales performance management.
Strong understanding of sales performance metrics, revenue analysis, profitability, and commercial KPIs.
Hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and business performance reporting.
Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with Power BI, SAP, Oracle, or other ERP and business intelligence tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and business interpretation skills.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.

Introducing Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain, an extraordinary addition to Raffles Hotel's renowned portfolio. This ultra-luxury property offers a unique experience as "The Palace of the Secret Garden." With 78 private pool villas ranging from 1 to 3 bedrooms, Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain redefines luxury hospitality in Bahrain. Our spacious villas, starting from 400 sqm, feature private pools and jacuzzis, providing guests with ultimate relaxation and privacy. Our dedicated team of Raffles Legendary Butlers ensures exceptional service and attention to detail, creating unforgettable moments for each guest. Conveniently located just 40 minutes from the airport and 30 minutes from the City Center, Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain offers easy access to Exhibition World Bahrain, Bahrain International Circuit (BIC), and the Al Dana Amphitheater, making it an ideal choice for cultural, entertainment, and business destinations.
